notes.title: UPDATE 5A
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone.[/h2][h2]Update 5A is here and here are some changes:[/h2][p][/p][p]-Individual Gibs added for every enemy, including bosses.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132304/4ccdb4dd89e212ecb37ab51c6ee9ecde5f0fcd60.gif"][/img][/p][p]-Skill Menu changed and some SFX added. The artworks from this menu is removed, I'm planing add new artworks in the future.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132304/55f13ba01aabdad5946675e2fdf76af9351b8417.jpg"][/img][/p][p]-New Skill "[b]Tax Evader[/b]" added. With this you can %40 more BP gain.[/p][p]-Shotgun's skill "Behive" now has better SFX.[/p][p]-New Hook Attack for Deagle added. [/p][p]-New Music for E1M2 is added, made by Revosider, thanks.[/p][p]-This section in E2M3 is changed. Now it's much larger. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132304/37def2c13e7a6cffe11a88f57e2e4b8a73a0007b.png"][/img][b]-E2M4 is added.
[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132304/35571927a2bb3e36b1728525e18b42999997f632.png"][/img][/p][p]-New Cenk (Player) model and Texture is added.[/p][p]-Custom Skin is added. Go to the game files and find the "mods" folder there should be skin.png file, you can change it to however you like. Currently his head is excluded from the texture.[/p][p]-Save file location has changed. Instead of "Cenk The Chopper/Cenk The Chopper_Data/save" it just uses "Cenk The Chopper/save" directory. You [b]DO NOT NEED[/b] to change your save files. 
Game will still read the old save files, however while writing new ones it'll write them into new directory, and read the new files if they exist.[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: -Individual Gibs added for every enemy, including bosses.
-Skill Menu changed and some SFX added. The artworks from this menu is removed, I'm planing add new artworks in the future.
-New Skill "Tax Evader" added. With this you can %40 more BP gain.
-New Music for E1M2 is added, made by Revosider, thanks.
-This section in E2M3 is changed. Now it's much larger.
-New Cenk (Player) model and Texture is added.
-Custom Skin is added. Go to the game files and find the "mods" folder there should be skin.png file, you can change it to however you like. Currently his head is excluded from the texture.

tags.bug:
-Save file location has changed. Instead of "Cenk The Chopper/Cenk The Chopper_Data/save" it just uses "Cenk The Chopper/save" directory. You [b]DO NOT NEED[/b] to change your save files. 
Game will still read the old save files, however while writing new ones it'll write them into new directory, and read the new files if they exist.
